method: SQLite mode=ro&immutable=1 + query_only against only frozen-4/frozen-5. No SDK/store constructors, no benchmark, no browser/provider/network; only new observation bytes are decompressed with checksums and ownership checked.

plugin.event.mode: 290 full event payloads; 24 decision payloads projected, all checked against the source DB.

performance.clockLimits: Wall-clock timestamp differences, not instrumented phase timers. capturedAt is assigned after DOM stability/detailed collection, before history/screenshot/ARIA/evidence writes. visit.at follows driver return, identity matching and initial state grouping. observation.created is emitted near transaction end after discovery, final projection, state/identity/action/frontier writes. No pure capture/projection/save duration can be isolated from these markers.

supplement.limits: Different real-world actions/observations, browser/session conditions and source changes. Timestamp markers overlap larger capture/action/recovery intervals. Do not sum them as disjoint CPU costs or attribute a performance change to one fix.

actionIndex.schema:
CREATE INDEX entities_action_observation ON entities(session_id,CASE WHEN compressed_json IS NULL AND json_valid(json) THEN
  CASE WHEN json_type(json,'$.observationId')='text'
    AND json_type(json_remove(json,'$.observationId'),'$.observationId') IS NULL
    AND instr(json,'\u')=0 AND json_type(json,'$.$interactionStorage') IS NULL
  THEN json_extract(json,'$.observationId') END END) WHERE kind='action'

queryPlan.detail: SEARCH entities USING INDEX entities_action_observation (session_id=? AND <expr>=?)

metricLimits: Stored candidate actions are not actual operations or semantic coverage.
DB payload includes indexes and record metadata; JSON/blob sums are lower-level counters and must not be added again to DB size.
dbstat unused pages/cells are not a measured VACUUM recovery amount; no compaction or writes were performed.
Timestamp intervals do not isolate projection, SQLite save, or CPU time. These real runs are not a controlled performance comparison.
Original DB, browser, services, provider and network were never accessed.
Inspection-only clock statistics are derived from existing timestamps, not benchmark executions.
